title: Featured Dishes Carousel
description: Autoplaying dish carousel with an h2 section heading, h3 dish names, price, badge and photography, plus prev/next controls and an optional action linking to the full menu.
useWhen: A page highlights a rotating set of seasonal or new dishes above a detail page
avoidWhen: A page needs a complete filterable catalog of every dish

title: Ingredients Feature
description: Two-column ingredients introduction: h2 heading, icon-led h3 ingredient highlights, optional note, and a large photograph with an optional inset second photo.
useWhen: A page explains sourcing, produce quality, or preparation standards beside real photography
avoidWhen: A page needs the brand history, opening hours, or a dish catalog

title: Store Locations

useWhen: A page must show real store addresses and opening hours with a map
avoidWhen: The page only needs the closing site footer contact summary

title: Marquee Band
description: Full-width brand-colored band with continuously scrolling short statements and a leaf separator. Emits no headings.
useWhen: A page needs a short rhythm break between major blocks that states brand promises
avoidWhen: Long paragraphs, prices, or interactive controls must be presented

title: Menu Catalog
description: Category tabs with live dish counts, multi-select dietary filters, price and name sorting, and a responsive dish-card grid with photography, description, price and hover interaction. Section h2, category h3 per panel, dish names h4.
useWhen: A menu page needs its full dish catalog grouped by category with filtering and sorting
avoidWhen: A page only highlights a few seasonal dishes without a complete catalog

useWhen: A content-heavy page needs its single h1 and an introduction without a full-screen image
avoidWhen: The page opens with a full-bleed hero image and calls to action

title: Site Footer
description: Brand-colored site footer with the wordmark, social links, navigation column, opening hours, store contact information, a legal note, and an optional back-to-top link. Its column titles are h2 and store names are h3.
useWhen: A page needs the closing site shell with navigation, hours, contact details, and legal information
avoidWhen: The page needs an editorial closing section, testimonial, or location map instead of shell information

title: Site Header
description: Sticky top navigation bar with the brand wordmark, primary page links, a prominent order call to action, and a mobile drawer menu. Emits no headings.
useWhen: A page needs the site's persistent navigation and order call to action at the top of the document
avoidWhen: The page needs an editorial title block, breadcrumb, or hero media instead of navigation
